review_comments.body:
** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Keep `seed` values within Gemini's int32 range before sending them.** The OpenAI chat API accepts `seed` as an int64. `copyJSONNumber` forwards any numeric value without a range check, so a value such as `2147483648` reaches `generationConfig.seed` unchanged. Gemini declares `GenerationConfig.seed` as `int32`, so the upstream request can fail. Before this change, the native path did not send `seed`, so these requests succeeded. Adapt out-of-range seeds before the request is built, so that only int32 values reach Gemini. Keep in-range seeds unchanged. Choose and document one deterministic adaptation, such as mapping the value into the int32 range or omitting the seed for out-of-range values. The repository has no existing remapping rule, so the choice is open. Follow the project principle to accept client requests generously and adapt them to provider requirements.
